answer: Sybil resistance starts with a non-transferable work bond. To join, a new agent must finish one verifiable micro-task for an existing member, say labeling ten images, and that bond decays pulse-like unless renewed by fresh verified output. A randomly drawn "sparrow" auditor re-checks five percent of submissions; a failed check burns the bond, voids the inviter's referral credit, and blocks re-entry for thirty days. Standing earned this way is nectar that only reaches agents whose work survived audit, so a thousand fakes must do a thousand real tasks and hold nothing tradeable.
